name: P-022 Round-Leader Dead-Heat Fade Maker (retrospective spec, calibration run)

entry_logic.close_reference_rule: On this family occurrence_datetime is a far-future placeholder (13.2-18.2d late, 10/10 sampled) and close_time is the correct anchor; this is the REVERSE of the top-N event-timing quirk in CLAUDE.md and must never be inferred by analogy.

anchor_price_band.reference: mid_price of the YES orderbook (best_bid, best_ask average) at time of evaluation
anchor_price_band.rule: eligible_to_quote iff 0.03 <= mid_price <= 0.12; recompute mid_price every cycle, do not cache

posting_window.rule: can_place_new_quote iff 12.0 <= hours_to_close(close_time) <= 24.0; once placed a quote RESTS UNCHANGED through the round to close, no re-quoting or re-pricing inside 12h
posting_window.outside_window_behavior: outside [12h,24h] the engine discovers markets and settles positions but places NO new quotes

excluded_from_entry: quotes placed inside 12h to close are non-compliant with the locked posting-window cap and must be excluded from T (P022_DECISION_RULE.md §7)

exit_logic.rule: No discretionary exit. A resting maker quote is either filled and held to settlement, or pulled (unfilled) via cap exhaustion or the kill switch.
quote_pull_triggers: data/KILL_ROUND_LEADER_FADE file present -> pull ALL resting quotes immediately
per-name, per-tournament, or aggregate collateral cap exhausted -> pull the specific quote that would breach it
mid_price exits [0.03, 0.12] band before fill on an unfilled resting quote -> re-evaluate/pull on next cycle

settlement_mapping.result_scalar: settlement_value = settlement_value_dollars, read from the per-ticker GET (never null); this is the $1/n dead-heat split or a withdrawal marked to fair value, and is a PARTIAL PAYOUT, NEVER a void
settlement_mapping.result_void: excluded from P&L entirely -- no risk was taken; applies only to a market that never resolved, not to result=scalar

fair_value_model.description: Fair value is not a probability estimate; it is the certified contract term that a tie for the round lead splits the $1.00 notional 1/n (rounded down) across tied names, per governing tour PDF (e.g. PGAROUNDLEADER). A single outright leader settles YES=1.00/NO=0.00 as usual.
fair_value_model.edge_definition: edge_per_contract = quote_px - E[settlement_value] - maker_fee(series, quote_px), where E[settlement_value] is realized (not modeled) at settlement
fair_value_model.mechanism_class: settlement-mechanic hypothesis, not a probability-disagreement hypothesis; no CLV substitute is valid for this family (round-leader markets have no sharp external closing line) per P022_DECISION_RULE.md §8.5

fee_model.computation: src.kalshi_fees.fee_per_contract(price, series_ticker=<ticker>) -- series_ticker MUST be passed explicitly; lookup is EXACT match against src/fixtures/kalshi_series_fees.json, no prefix logic
fee_model.assertion: all 13 series in this spec's `series` list are classified `quadratic` (maker-fee-free); verified live via `python3 -m scripts.p022_checkpoint --check-fees`, which asserts rather than assumes fee==0 per contract on every *LEAD series
fee_model.taker_fee_not_applicable: P-022 is maker-only (sells YES / makes NO resting orders); taker fee formula 0.07*P*(1-P) does not apply to this strategy's own fills

risk_limits.sizing_basis: collateral_at_risk = (1 - quote_px) per contract, NEVER contract count
risk_limits.cap_enforcement_rule: each new quote is sized to the tightest remaining of {per-name, per-tournament, aggregate} cap; the quote is pulled the instant any cap is exhausted
risk_limits.cap_scope_caveat: P-022 runs as its own process; AggregateRiskGuard reservations (reserve_trade on quote, release_reservation on pull) bind against P-022's OWN book only -- the aggregate 15% cap is NOT enforced against the 5-minute engine's other positions
risk_limits.cap_is_gate_condition: these caps are GATE CONDITIONS, not tuning knobs, per P022_DECISION_RULE.md §7/§8.1: a tournament run with ANY cap breached is EXCLUDED from T and from the aggregate (it cannot contribute a favorable observation); raising ANY of the percentages above resets T to 0 and requires re-registration as a new pod ID (P-022b). This spec MUST NOT and does NOT loosen any of the values above.
risk_limits.posting_window_is_a_cap: the [12h,24h] posting window in entry_logic is itself a cap; quotes placed inside 12h are excluded from T

null_hypothesis: Net of the maker fee (asserted zero for this series family) and net of adverse selection in live resting fills, the equal-weighted-across-tournament, contract-weighted-within-tournament mean settlement P&L per filled contract for selling YES in [0.03,0.12] at mid+0.02, posted 12-24h pre-round on KX*R{1,2,3}LEAD, is not reliably positive: at T>=24 tournament observations (P022_DECISION_RULE.md §2-3 unit of observation and test statistic), edge <= 0 or z < 2.0. Equivalently: the +3.4c/ct [+1.7,+5.1] Phase-2 backtest estimate fails to replicate forward and the dead-heat/longshot mechanism does not survive real maker-fill adverse selection at tradeable size.
alternative_hypothesis: The $1/n dead-heat settlement split plus retail longshot overpricing on cheap round-leader names produces a persistent, fee-free, adverse-selection-robust positive net edge (Phase-2 backtest: +3.4c/ct net, 95% CI [+1.7,+5.1], 16/19 tournaments positive, fill rate 0.47) that replicates forward at T>=24 with edge>0 and z>=2.0 per P022_DECISION_RULE.md §4, authorizing (paper-only) continued allocation within the §7 caps.

extra.purpose: RETROSPECTIVE CALIBRATION SPEC. P-022 is already built and running in paper (systemd unit betting-round-leader-fade). This spec documents the rule the shipped implementation should satisfy, for validator calibration against a known-answer case -- it is not a discovery artifact.
alternative_hypotheses: Primary (stated in alternative_hypothesis above): the mechanism replicates forward and passes the locked gate.

Alternative-B (partial regression): the effect is real but smaller than backtest (regression toward zero from a one-month, non-holdout sample per P022_DECISION_RULE.md §6), producing the marginal-result path (0 < edge, z < 2.0 at T=24) that triggers the single pre-registered extension to T=40 at byte-identical parameters, per §4a.
Alternative-C (mechanism absent forward): adverse selection dominates in live resting fills to the point of flipping sign, producing the HARD KILL condition z <= -2.0 at any T, per §4.
extra.boundary_not_to_cross: This spec does NOT compute, estimate, or report any live forward-gate statistic (edge, se, z, T, or verdict). As of 2026-08-01 T=0 for this pod; P022_DECISION_RULE.md makes T<24 NO DECISION and forbids an early look. scripts/p022_checkpoint.py is the ONLY sanctioned reader of forward results and is not invoked by this artifact.
extra.decision_rule_locked_reference: golf_quirks_research/P022_DECISION_RULE.md, LOCKED 2026-07-26, Amendment 1 2026-07-28 (T=14 -> T=24). This spec reproduces its thresholds verbatim (HARD KILL z<=-2.0 at any T; NO DECISION T<24; KILL if T>=24 and edge<=0; single extension to T=40 if T>=24, edge>0, z<2.0; PASS if T>=24 and edge>0 and z>=2.0; KILL at T>=40 if edge>0 and z<2.0) and does not loosen, restate-looser, or omit any of them.
extra.unit_of_observation: ONE tournament = one observation (KXPGAR1LEAD-XXX26 and KXPGAR2LEAD-XXX26 of the same event pool to ONE observation, not two). Within-tournament statistic is contract-weighted mean net c/contract; across-tournament aggregate is equal-weighted mean of per-tournament statistics.
extra.test_statistic_reference: P022_DECISION_RULE.md §3: x_t = contract-weighted mean pnl_per_contract within tournament t; edge = mean(x_t); se = stdev(x_t)/sqrt(T); z = edge/se. VOIDs excluded; scalar settlements NEVER excluded and NEVER booked at $0.
extra.params_source: golf_quirks_research/p022_p023_params.json (p022_round_leader_fade block), generated_utc 2026-07-26, values used verbatim -- band [0.03,0.12], anchor_hours_before_close 12, offset 0.02, side sell_yes, maker_fee 0.0, research_quote_size 25.
extra.implementation_reference: src/round_leader_fade_maker.py (RoundLeaderFadeMakerPod, @register_pod("P-022")); scripts/run_round_leader_fade.py (standalone fast-loop runner, NOT in pods.active, kill switch data/KILL_ROUND_LEADER_FADE); tests/test_round_leader_fade.py (21 tests).
known_failure_modes_carried_forward: Adverse selection on the maker side (E[settle|filled] 3.2c vs posted 1.8c in Phase-2 -- does not flip sign but is real)
One-sided fills: filling only the leg that goes on to lose
Capacity is small by construction (~$140/month projected at 25-ct caps) -- not a reason to loosen caps
close_time vs occurrence_datetime reversal is family-specific and was a total quoting blocker for 3 days (2026-07-23 to 2026-07-26) before the fix
result=scalar must never be booked VOID -- doing so deletes the exact event the strategy exists to harvest
